cups (500 g) of fruits and 2 1/2 cups (600 g) of vegetables. As one new runner
sheepishly remarked, “I’m lucky if I eat that much in a week.” The trick is to
eat large portions. Most runners can easily enjoy a banana (which counts as 
1 cup of fruit) and 8 ounces (1 cup/ 240 ml) of orange juice in the morning.
That’s the minimal two cups of fruit for the day! A big bowl of salad filled with
colorful tomato, carrot and pepper can account for the minimal recommended
2 1/2 cups of vegetables.
